WITH element_pairs AS (
  SELECT
    c.bond_id,
    -- Get the elements for both atoms
    a1.element AS element1,
    a2.element AS element2,
    -- Sort the elements so (C,H) and (H,C) are treated the same
    CASE WHEN a1.element < a2.element THEN a1.element ELSE a2.element END AS elem_a,
    CASE WHEN a1.element < a2.element THEN a2.element ELSE a1.element END AS elem_b
  FROM connected c
  JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
  JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
  WHERE c.bond_id IS NOT NULL
),
pair_counts AS (
  SELECT
    elem_a,
    elem_b,
    COUNT(*) AS pair_count
  FROM element_pairs
  GROUP BY elem_a, elem_b
),
most_common AS (
  SELECT
    elem_a,
    elem_b,
    pair_count
  FROM pair_counts
  ORDER BY pair_count DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
total_bonds AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) AS total
  FROM connected
  WHERE bond_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  m.elem_a,
  m.elem_b,
  m.pair_count,
  t.total,
  ROUND(100.0 * m.pair_count / t.total, 2) AS percentage
FROM most_common m, total_bonds t
